briefs.brief_text: Need a developer to scrape real estate listings from Redfin daily to CSV.
briefs.proposal_text:
I reviewed your requirements: "Need a developer to scrape real estate listings from Redfin daily to CSV....".

Here is my 3-step action plan:
1. Analyze and isolate target data endpoints / workflow logic.
2. Develop a resilient script with built-in error handling and rate-limit safety.
3. Format output cleanly to your exact specification.

I can deliver an initial verified sample within 24 hours. Let me know if you'd like to review a quick demo!
